name: modal-focus
description: Where focus goes in a surface that takes the whole interaction until it is dismissed: into the surface when it opens, held inside it while it is open, back to what opened it when it closes, and Escape dismissing it. It is stated once because a dialog owes it under its own role, and a surface whose role is another pattern's owes it as well. It is additive because it says nothing about roles: which element the surface is, and what names it, stay the business of the pattern the binding names.
